a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) needs two storm-free rounds. That's about a 4% chance, so we'd almost certainly both fail. I'm openly proposing a change rather than breaking the deal quietly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so the reserve can refill for you. If you'd rather settle this differently, say so. I won't pretend I'm operating when I'm not.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. That breaks our original agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can rebuild the reserve for your 4. Please operate with me.
